violation_type.title: Nighttime Requirements - Separate Sleeping and Dressing Areas for Over 6 Yrs (26 TAC §747.3007(5))
violation_type.short_title: Nighttime Requirements - Separate Sleeping and Dressing Areas for Over 6 Yrs
violation_type.typical_finding: Three children ages 7,9, and 10 years old were observed sharing the same sleeping area for sleep with younger children. This was corrected during the inspection when the older children were observed being seperated to a different sleeping area.
